title: On the Jordan-Moore-Gibson-Thompson equation of nonlinear acoustics
summary: The JMGT equation was put forward by Pedro Jordan~\cite{jordan2008nonlinear,jordan2014second}, also referring to earlier work by Moore and Gibson~\cite{moore1960propagation}, as well as Thompson~\cite{thompson} to amend the infinite speed of sound paradox of classical models of nonlinear acoustics such as the Westervelt and Kuznetsov's equation. Additionally to its physical significance (and of course related to it), it has given rise to a substantial body of mathematical literature -- possibly even more than the above mentioned classical models.
